model: RandomForestClassifier (scikit-learn, n_estimators=500, random_state=42), stratified 80/20 split, no preprocessing
notes: Zeros in insulin, skin_thickness, etc. were kept as-is (likely missing values). 57 duplicate rows were kept; 14 test rows also occur in train, and accuracy on the 171 non-overlapping test rows is 0.906.
